Resolved an Excel lookup question: XLOOKUP initially failed for about half the 'Oct AP' rows due to invisible characters (trailing and non-breaking spaces). - [décision] The 3 remaining unmatched rows (Northpeak Talent, AWS Marketplace) will be fixed manually, no alias table will be built (source: t09)
